mechanism: openstacksdk adds backup_id to the Volume resource schema, so python-openstackclient's generic volume-create output gains an unexpected column
repair_template: exclude the newly exposed SDK field from python-openstackclient's generic volume output until the target intentionally supports it

semantic_review.a1_failure: On the unchanged python-openstackclient opening-cutoff snapshot, the pre-existing minimum-options volume-create test passes with the old openstacksdk source and fails only after openstacksdk adds backup_id: the actual output columns contain backup_id while the target's established expected columns do not; the stable exclusive signature is testtools.matchers._impl.MismatchError: !=:.

The same pre-existing one-test stestr command ran in every arm, with 1/1 passing in A0 and A2 and exactly that test failing in A1. semantic_review.source_effect: The source opening adds backup_id as a declared openstacksdk Volume field. python-openstackclient derives generic output columns from that resource schema, so the unchanged target exposes an additional backup_id column in A1.
semantic_review.target_repair: The exact maintainer patch applies to the public opening-cutoff python-openstackclient snapshot and adds backup_id to the production ignored_columns set, removing only that newly exposed field from generic output; it makes no test-file changes.
